image_description: A colorful baby bib lying flat on a white textured surface. The bib features vertical stripes in orange, green, and white. It has a central rectangular patch with cartoon animal illustrations (a giraffe, an elephant, and another figure). The bib has a rounded bottom edge, a curved neck opening reinforced with blue piping, and two long blue fabric ties extending from the sides of the neck area.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bib and distinguish it from similar apparel like aprons or vests.
To verify the structural integrity of the ties and the central patch, ensuring no fusion artifacts or floating elements.
To assess the realism of the fabric texture, stitching details, and lighting consistency on the white background.
To check if the cartoon characters contain any gibberish text or distorted lettering, which is a common AI artifact.

focus_areas: Connection points of the blue ties to the main body
Stitching consistency along the orange border
Clarity and coherence of the cartoon animal illustrations
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the central cartoon patch. AI often distorts faces or limbs in small printed graphics. Verify if the animals are structurally sound. Also, inspect the blue ties for any 'melting' into the background or unnatural thickness variations.
